Known for his indomitable "iron will" and a unique Power Ring, he possesses the extraordinary ability to conjure anything he imagines. This makes him one of the mightiest figures in the DC universe, highlighting his significant role and distinctive capabilities within the expansive comic book lore.

articles.title: Why India is doubling down on Russian air defense systems
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence recently signed a 4.5 billion INR ($46 million) contract with Russia's state-owned Rosoboronexport for the procurement of Tunguska air defence missiles. This strategic acquisition aims to bolster India's air defence capabilities, crucial for national security and military modernization. Such defence deals highlight India's ongoing efforts to strengthen its armed forces and secure its airspace.

articles.title: Beyond the Manifesto: Recovering the Women Writers of Italian Futurism
articles.summary: An article by Lucia Wolf discusses the historical significance of Filippo Tommaso Marinetti's founding manifesto. Marinetti, a pivotal Italian figure, used this document to launch Futurism, an influential avant-garde movement advocating modernism, speed, and technology. The article likely explores the manifesto's radical ideas and profound cultural impact on early 20th-century European thought.

articles.title: Lex Legion, New Band Featuring Classic King Diamond Members, Unleash First Single “Sleep Eternally”: Stream
articles.summary: Lex Legion, a new band featuring four classic ’80s members of the iconic metal group King Diamond, has unveiled their debut single, “Sleep Eternally.” These musicians were integral to King Diamond's acclaimed albums “Them” and “Conspiracy.” The release marks a significant return for these experienced artists, bringing fresh material to their global fanbase.

articles.title: Validity and reliability of Indonesian version of the digital screen exposure questionnaire (DSEQ) for young children
articles.summary: Recent studies underscore the critical impact of excessive screen time on early childhood development, posing significant challenges to cognitive and social growth. Proactive assessment and intervention regarding children's screen exposure are crucial to prevent long-term negative developmental effects, ensuring a healthier and more capable future generation ready to contribute nationally.
